Generated from profiles.json by scripts/profiles_split.py; edit profiles.json, never this file. The fields of each profile are those listed in profiles.json's _schema.

fields.profiles: {candidate id: profile}, exactly as in profiles.json

summary.text: Belinda Wilson is the Labor MP for Narre Warren North, which she won at the 2022 state election after Luke Donnellan retired. She has been Deputy Government Whip in the Assembly since February 2023. She is recontesting Narre Warren North in 2026.

occupation.text: Electorate officer; also worked in business

prior_roles.role: Electorate officer for federal MP Josh Burns

priorities.text: Good local schools for every family
Progress on treaty and truth-telling with Victoria's First Nations people

summary.text: Cristina Emmanuel is the Family First candidate for Narre Warren North at the 2026 Victorian election, on the VEC's list of nominations. Her party profile says she migrated from Sri Lanka, grew up in the City of Casey and is a single mother of three. It says she has an accounting degree from RMIT University, works supporting elderly Victorians and had earlier worked in youth justice centres in a support role.

prior_roles.role: Community support worker, youth justice centres
Volunteer, school finance and parents' committees

priorities.text: Tackling crime and making neighbourhoods safer
A fair, planned and sustainable immigration program

summary.text: Hayley Perry is the Greens candidate for Narre Warren North at the 2026 Victorian election. She runs a small advertising agency, works as a project coordinator and is raising a family. She stood for the Greens in Berwick at the 2022 state election.

occupation.text: Runs a small advertising agency; project coordinator

priorities.text: Let's tax big corporations and help everyday people with the cost of living.
Let's protect our area and look after people in our community.

sources.title: Narre Warren North: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
Hayley Perry, Candidate for Narre Warren North, Victorian Greens
Candidates of the 2022 Victorian state election, Wikipedia

summary.text: Joshua Utoyo is the Libertarian candidate for Narre Warren North at the 2026 Victorian election. The ABC says he runs a business making 3D-printed goods and once served as the party's Victorian secretary. At the 2025 federal election he stood for the Libertarians in Menzies.

sources.title: Narre Warren North: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
Candidates of the 2025 Australian federal election, Wikipedia

summary.text: Lachlan McCracken is the Victorian Socialists candidate for Narre Warren North at the 2026 Victorian election. A father of two, he says he was raised by a single mother in a renting family and has done blue-collar work since the age of 14. His campaign centres on housing, job security and family visas.

priorities.text: A five-year rent freeze, much more public housing and penalties on investors who leave homes empty
Automatic casual conversion rights and stronger union access to workplaces
Guaranteed housing for women and children escaping family violence
Implementing the Bringing Them Home report and funding First Nations-run family support

sources.title: Narre Warren North: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Martin Leahy is the Legalise Cannabis Victoria candidate for Narre Warren North at the 2026 Victorian election, on the VEC's list of nominations. The ABC's guide gave no biography for this candidate as at 9 Nov 2026, and we found no other published profile.

sources.title: Candidates for Narre Warren North District, Victorian Electoral Commission
Narre Warren North, 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Sebastian Crutchfield is the One Nation candidate for Narre Warren North at the 2026 Victorian election. The ABC's guide says he is managing director of his family's construction business, which builds roads and civil infrastructure in Victoria. One Nation's page for him refused our requests, so the ABC is the only source here.

occupation.text: Managing director, family construction company (roads and civil infrastructure)

sources.title: Narre Warren North: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Shemane Nathanielsz is the Liberal candidate for Narre Warren North at the 2026 Victorian election. She was a registered nurse for 25 years, 12 of them in Endeavour Hills, and sits on the board of the Beaconsfield District Community Bank. The ABC says she now liaises with local community groups and businesses for an MP's electorate office.

occupation.text: Community and business liaison officer in an electorate office

priorities.text: A weekly cap of $50 on tolls to ease living costs
The Liberal plan to cut crime and living costs and make government work better

sources.title: Narre Warren North: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
Shemane Nathanielsz, Liberal for Narre Warren North, Liberal Victoria
